tree.heading: Advisory panel
tree.text: The term “advisory panel” means the Advisory Panel on Pacific Hake/Whiting established by the Agreement.

tree.heading: Agreement
tree.text: The term “Agreement” means the Agreement between the Government of the United States and the Government of Canada on Pacific Hake/Whiting, signed at Seattle, Washington, on November 21, 2003.

tree.heading: Catch
tree.text: The term “catch” means all fishery removals from the offshore whiting resource, including landings, discards, and bycatch in other fisheries.

tree.heading: Joint management committee
tree.text: The term “joint management committee” means the joint management committee established by the Agreement.

tree.heading: Joint technical committee
tree.text: The term “joint technical committee” means the joint technical committee established by the Agreement.

tree.heading: Offshore whiting resource
tree.text: The term “offshore whiting resource” means the transboundary stock of Merluccius productus that is located in the offshore waters of the United States and Canada except in Puget Sound and the Strait of Georgia.

tree.heading: Scientific review group
tree.text: The term “scientific review group” means the scientific review group established by the Agreement.

tree.heading: Secretary
tree.text: The term “Secretary” means the Secretary of Commerce.

tree.heading: United States Section
tree.text: The term “United States Section” means the United States representatives on the joint management committee.

notes.heading: Short Title
notes.text: Pub. L. 109–479, title VI, § 601, Jan. 12, 2007, 120 Stat. 3644, provided that: “This title [enacting this chapter] may be cited as the ‘Pacific Whiting Act of 2006’.”
